slides.title: Landscapers adding snow removal this winter: quick quiz

slides.myth: My landscaping insurance automatically covers plowing.
slides.fact: Not necessarily. Plowing can be treated as a different risk. Ask your agent before the first storm.

slides.myth: The property manager has my COI from spring. I'm good.
slides.fact: If your policy renews in December, they'll often want the new certificate.

slides.title: Check the truck registration and permits before the first storm.
slides.body: Not at 5 AM with the blade on. Save this before the first snow.
